exact_general_statement: For any odd prime p, integer k>=1, N=p^k, and integer 1<=i<=N/p, set h=q0^p q1+q1^p q0, F=p^-i h^i Z0^(N-pi), with T={0}, nu=r0=r1=1 and height-1 column counts N at 0 and i at 1. If r counts odd positive e with N/p^e>i, delta=(k+1)+ell_p(i)+(k+1)^2, and v=v_p(N!)+v_p(i!)-i, then v-B=delta+(r-1)i+v_p(i!)+(N*p^(1-2r)-i)/(p^2-1)-1/(p-1)>0. For r>=1, N*p^(1-2r)>i; for r=0, i=N/p and expression reduces to delta+v_p(i!)-1/(p-1)>0. This proves this entire specialization of PHT.1753 by elementary algebra; not the general theorem.
